story.sounders.name: The Sounders' Song
story.sounders.desc: A side story: the rune stones are singing. Follow their song to the hidden home of the Sounders.
story.sounders.ch.s1.sum: The rune stones are not letters. They are notes. Play them and listen.
story.sounders.ch.s2.sum: Eight singing pillars are waiting for an answer.
story.sounders.ch.s3.sum: Discs of black glass remember words. Decode them with the note alphabet.
story.sounders.ch.s4.sum: The discs hold building plans. Build what the Sounders built.
story.sounders.ch.s5.sum: Someone is still singing at the old stones.
story.sounders.ch.s6.sum: Four voices, one song. It leads home.
story.sounders.ch.s8.sum: Some songs must not be sung again. Others must be sung together.
story.sounders.s1.notes.start: Did you hear that? These aren't letters at all — they're notes! The old archive read a song as if it were a letter.
story.sounders.s1.play.start: Every stone sings one word. Play rune stones with {key:Interact} — at ruins and monuments, wherever you find them.
story.sounders.s1.play.hint: Rune stones carry painted notes. Monuments have lots of them — I marked the nearest one.
story.sounders.s1.play.hint_away: No monuments on this world. Look for ruins — or try another world.
story.sounders.s1.play.done: Three words! I'm keeping every word in a Song Archive in your Journal.
story.sounders.s1.together.start: If stones can sing, somewhere they must sing together. The archive knows a place with eight of them.
story.sounders.s2.shrine.start: The Singing Shrine! Strike one of its eight pillars with {key:Interact}. It sings first — then you answer.
story.sounders.s2.shrine.hint: Listen, then strike the pillars in the same order. Wrong notes don't matter — just try again.
story.sounders.s2.shrine.done: It answered! Something came up from the middle: an old spindle and a disc of black glass.
story.sounders.s2.ring.start: There's no Singing Shrine in these skies. So we build one: eight rune stones in a circle around an ancient brick.
story.sounders.s2.ring.chip: Build a ring of runes and answer it
story.sounders.s2.ring.hint: Mine rune stones at ruins. Place eight in a circle, an ancient brick in the middle, then strike a stone.
story.sounders.s2.ring.done: The ring answered! An old spindle and a disc of black glass are in your backpack now.
story.sounders.s3.place.start: Place the Song Spindle somewhere. It wants to sing.
story.sounders.s3.decode.start: Hold the disc and use the spindle with {key:Interact}. Listen closely — two notes make one letter.
story.sounders.s3.decode.hint: The note table in the Song Archive fills in as you learn. Take your time.
story.sounders.s3.decode.done: Those are words! Every letter is two notes. The Sounders wrote in song.
story.sounders.s3.sorry.start: Those monument runes I read to you… the archive was only guessing. They were never letters. Sorry — and wow!
story.sounders.s3.more.start: There must be more discs. Relic caches at monuments often hide old things.
story.sounders.s3.more.hint: Loot relic caches at monuments, then bring each disc to your spindle.
story.sounders.s3.more.done: These two aren't stories — they're building plans!
story.sounders.s4.plans.start: Alien blueprints! I put them on your research list. You'll need obsidian, rune stones and crystal.
story.sounders.s4.research.start: Research both Sounder blueprints in the cockpit.
story.sounders.s4.research.hint: Open the research list in the cockpit. The Sounder plans are at the end.
story.sounders.s4.research.done: Done. Let's see what the Sounders built.
story.sounders.s4.blaster.start: Build the Resonance Blaster. It doesn't hurt anyone — it pushes, and it makes stones ring.
story.sounders.s4.chamber.start: Aim the blaster at a monument's rune stone and use it. Some monuments are hollow inside.
story.sounders.s4.chamber.hint: Stand at a monument, aim at a rune stone, and use the Resonance Blaster.
story.sounders.s4.chamber.done: A hidden chamber! And another disc.
story.sounders.s4.great.start: Take the new disc to your spindle.
story.sounders.s4.great.done: They all sang together, to save their world. And then they were gone.
story.sounders.s4.armour.start: Now the obsidian armour. Its chest piece has a socket for a disc.
story.sounders.s4.armour.hint: You need the Sounder armour blueprint, obsidian and crystal.
story.sounders.s4.socket.start: Put on the chest piece and put the hearing disc into its socket.
story.sounders.s4.socket.hint: Open your suit, wear the obsidian chest, then put the hearing disc into the disc slot.
story.sounders.s4.socket.done: …Do you hear that? A voice. Very far away. Or very close.
story.sounders.s5.elora.start: The voice comes from the Singing Shrine. Go there with the hearing disc — and be gentle.
story.sounders.s5.elora.start_away: The voice is near rune stones. Wear the hearing disc and listen at a ruin, a monument or your own ring.
story.sounders.s5.elora.chip: Find the voice at the shrine
story.sounders.s5.elora.chip_away: Find the voice at the rune stones
story.sounders.s5.elora.hint: Wear the obsidian chest with the hearing disc and stand among the rune stones.
story.sounders.s5.elora.done: Elora. She isn't a ghost. She says she is "on the other side".
story.sounders.s5.more.start: Elora says three more Echoes are listening at other stones. Visit rune stones far from here.
story.sounders.s5.more.hint: An Echo waits at rune stones you haven't heard yet — far from the last Echo.
story.sounders.s5.tini.start: One Echo is still missing: Tini, the star singer. She sings on another world.
story.sounders.s5.tini.hint: Fly to another world and listen at its rune stones with the hearing disc.
story.sounders.s5.tini.done: Tini knew the name of their star: Ornemis.
story.sounders.s5.truth.start: They aren't dead. The Great Song carried them into the Qualis' world. And the Qualis were the ones getting hurt.
story.sounders.s6.letters.start: Each Echo gave us letters: O-R, N-E, M-I and S. Together they spell the star's name: ORNEMIS.
story.sounders.s6.play.start: Play the whole name at the Singing Shrine: ORNEMIS, two notes per letter.
story.sounders.s6.play.start_ring: Play the whole name at your ring of runes: ORNEMIS, two notes per letter.
story.sounders.s6.play.hint: The note table is in the Song Archive. O is F then E, R is G then D.
story.sounders.s6.play.done: It answered a fifth higher. Your ship is in tune now — Ornemis is on your star chart!
story.sounders.s7.jump.start: Set course for Ornemis. You'll need a jump drive for the hyperjump.
story.sounders.s7.jump.hint: Open the star chart. Ornemis is marked. A jump generator gets you there.
story.sounders.s7.land.start: Soaniri! Land wherever you like — the whole planet is singing.
story.sounders.s7.eldest.start: There's a village down there: Mirun. Living Sounders! Let's say hello — quietly.
story.sounders.s7.eldest.hint: The village is marked. Talk to the Eldest with {key:Interact}.
story.sounders.s7.eldest.done: The Eldest is worried. The Young Voices went to the Choir Tower to sing the Final Song.
story.sounders.s7.myth.start: The Final Song… that's what they call the Great Song now. They think their people rose to a better place.
story.sounders.s8.roll.start: To the Choir Tower! Talk to Roll before the Young Voices start singing.
story.sounders.s8.roll.chip: Talk to Roll at the Choir Tower
story.sounders.s8.roll.hint: Tell Roll what the Echoes told you. If Roll isn't convinced, try another answer.
story.sounders.s8.roll.done: Roll will listen. They sing the Song of Return — you play the second voice.
story.sounders.s8.bridge.start: Strike the tower's eight pipes and play the second voice to their song.
story.sounders.s8.bridge.hint: The melody bar lights up the next note. Wrong notes don't matter — just try again.
story.sounders.s8.bridge.done: Some songs don't need to be sung to the end. They just need to be sung together.
story.sounders.s8.listen.start: Listen. They can hear each other again. And the Qualis are calm.
story.sounders.s8.soundi.start: Someone has been following you all along… The little Soundi wants to sing with you!
story.sounders.s8.soundi.hint: Use {key:Interact} on the Soundi. It sings first — answer with the same notes.
story.sounders.s8.soundi.done: It chose you! Give your Soundi a name.
story.sounders.cut.stones.vega: Those painted marks on the stone… they aren't letters. They're notes!
story.sounders.cut.decoded.title: The note alphabet
story.sounders.cut.blueprint.title: Alien blueprints
story.sounders.cut.chamber.title: A sound chamber
story.sounders.cut.echo.elora: Someone can hear me? After so long?
story.sounders.cut.echo.vega: She's see-through… but she isn't a ghost. Let's listen.
story.sounders.cut.great.1: Long ago the Sounders sang their world into shape: bridges, towers, bread. But each song broke something on the other side, in the world of the Qualis.
story.sounders.cut.great.2: The Qualis took the Sounders' food to make the songs stop. Nobody understood why. So all the Sounders gathered at the Choir Tower and sang the Great Song together.
story.sounders.cut.great.3: The song grew so strong that it carried every singer away, into the Qualis' world. Only the few who did not sing stayed behind.
story.sounders.cut.return.title: Ornemis
story.sounders.cut.return.vega: Now our ship knows its song. Ornemis is on the star chart!
story.sounders.cut.arrival.title: Ornemis
story.sounders.cut.arrival.vega: The whole system is humming. It's… beautiful.
story.sounders.cut.landing.title: Soaniri
story.sounders.cut.landing.vega: Singing plants, Soundis… and over there, a village.
story.sounders.cut.elder.1: Our songs say our people rose to a higher place with the Final Song.
story.sounders.cut.elder.2: Go to the Choir Tower, star traveller. Bring our young ones home.
story.sounders.cut.tower.roll: Sing, all of you! Tonight we follow them!
story.sounders.cut.tower.vega: The sky is shimmering… the Qualis can feel it.
story.sounders.cut.bridge.1: The Qualis drift closer — and grow calm, glowing softly.
story.sounders.cut.bridge.elora: We hear you. We were never gone. Thank you, listener.
story.sounders.cut.bridge.eldest: I hear them… our grandmothers are singing.
story.sounders.cut.bridge.roll: We almost made the same mistake. We'll listen from now on.
story.sounders.cut.bridge.vega: Some songs don't need to be sung to the end. They just need to be sung together.
story.sounders.cut.soundi.title: A Soundi
story.sounders.cut.epilogue.text: The Sounders of Soaniri hum again — and they listen. Where rune stones stand, the Echoes still sing on the other side. And somewhere above, the Qualis drift in peace.
story.sounders.cut.epilogue.credits: Sounders, Soundis, Soundelings and Soundraks: ideas from Justus and the school club "Building Games with AI"
story.sounders.lore.mon_builders: Song inscription: "We sang a bridge, and the river let us cross. We sang a roof, and the rain went round."
story.sounders.lore.mon_tuning: Song inscription: "Every stone of this ring is tuned. Strike them in order, and the sky answers."
story.sounders.lore.mon_hunger: Song inscription: "The fields were full at dusk and empty at dawn. Nobody heard a thief."
story.sounders.lore.mon_gathering: Song inscription: "All voices, one song, at the tower. The little ones stay on the hill and listen."
story.sounders.lore.mon_after: Song inscription: "We who stayed will hum, not sing. Let no song build again."
story.sounders.lore.shrine_listen: The keepers hum that the shrine was built to listen, not to speak. "It waits for an answer," one of them says.
story.sounders.lore.ruin_lullaby: Notes on a cracked stone, decoded: "Sleep, small ear, the stars are humming." A lullaby.
story.sounders.lore.ruin_market: Notes on a doorpost, decoded: "Today's song: three loaves, one jar of light." A shopping list — sung.
story.sounders.archive.table.title: The note alphabet
story.sounders.archive.table.text: Every letter is two notes. The first note picks the row, the second the column: C-C is A, C-D is B, D-C is E … A short pause comes between letters, a long one between words.
story.sounders.word.text: A word the rune stones sing. You heard it and kept it in the Song Archive.
story.sounders.disc.beginning.title: The first disc
story.sounders.disc.beginning.text: "We sang, and it was. A wall where we sang 'wall'. Bread where we sang 'bread'. Our song made our world."
story.sounders.disc.builders.title: The builders' disc
story.sounders.disc.builders.text: "For the builders: a horn that sings stones open, and a voice that pushes without hurting."
story.sounders.disc.hearing.title: The hearing disc
story.sounders.disc.hearing.text: "A black coat that listens. Put this disc into its heart, and you will hear the other side."
story.sounders.disc.hunger.title: The disc of hunger
story.sounders.disc.hunger.text: "The fields emptied overnight. The wells ran dry. Something was taking — and nobody saw who."
story.sounders.disc.great_song.title: The disc of the Great Song
story.sounders.disc.great_song.text: "Tonight we all sing the Great Song at the Choir Tower. Our song made the world. Our song will save it."
story.sounders.disc.voices.title: The disc of voices
story.sounders.disc.voices.text: "For young singers: two voices to practise with. Sing them softly."
story.sounders.echo.elora.title: Elora, the singer
story.sounders.echo.elora.text: "We are not gone. We are on the other side, where the Lights live. You can hear us only where the stones are thin."
story.sounders.echo.kamo.title: Kamo, the builder
story.sounders.echo.kamo.text: "Every wall we sang here cracked a wall over there. We never listened to the other side."
story.sounders.echo.feya.title: Feya, keeper of the fields
story.sounders.echo.feya.text: "The Qualis took our harvest to make our songs stop. They were frightened. So were we."
story.sounders.echo.tini.title: Tini, the star singer
story.sounders.echo.tini.text: "Our star is called Ornemis. Sing its name where the eight stones stand, and your ship will find the way."
story.sounders.q.letters: Will you give me your letters?
story.sounders.dlg.elora.n0: (A tall, see-through figure hums softly. VEGA translates.) "Someone can hear me? After so long?"
story.sounders.dlg.elora.n0.r: "I am Elora. I sang at this shrine long ago — and I still sing, on the other side."
story.sounders.dlg.elora.n1: "You wear a listening heart. Then listen: we are not gone."
story.sounders.dlg.elora.n1.r: "We sang the Great Song to save our world. It carried us away instead, into the world of the Lights."
story.sounders.dlg.elora.n2: "Three others still listen at the old stones. Each of us keeps letters of the way home."
story.sounders.dlg.elora.n2.r: "Mine are O and R. Remember them — sing them, don't write them."
story.sounders.dlg.kamo.n0: (The Echo turns its long ears towards you.) "A listener! Do you build things too?"
story.sounders.dlg.kamo.n0.r: "Kamo. I sang bridges and towers. A whole tower in one song!"
story.sounders.dlg.kamo.n1: "But every wall we sang here cracked a wall on the other side."
story.sounders.dlg.kamo.n1.r: "We never noticed. Our songs were too loud to hear anything else."
story.sounders.dlg.feya.n0: (The Echo hums very quietly.) "Shh. Can you hear the fields? I kept them, once."
story.sounders.dlg.feya.n0.r: "Feya. My fields were full at dusk and empty at dawn."
story.sounders.dlg.feya.n1: "It was the Lights — the Qualis. Our songs broke their home, so they took our food to make us stop."
story.sounders.dlg.feya.n1.r: "They weren't angry, I think. They were frightened. Like us."
story.sounders.dlg.tini.n0: (This Echo is facing the sky.) "You came all this way? I sing to the stars."
story.sounders.dlg.tini.n0.r: "Tini. I counted the stars for the singers."
story.sounders.dlg.tini.n1: "Our star has a name. The others gave you its letters, didn't they?"
story.sounders.dlg.tini.n1.r: "Then the last one is mine: S. Together they spell Ornemis."
story.sounders.dlg.tini.n2: "Sing Ornemis where the eight stones stand, and your ship will hear the way. And please — tell the living to listen, not to sing."
story.sounders.dlg.eldest.n0: (The Eldest hums a greeting. VEGA translates.) "A star traveller who knows our song? Welcome to Mirun."
story.sounders.dlg.eldest.r0: "Echoes? Our songs say our people rose to a higher place with the Final Song."
story.sounders.dlg.eldest.n1: "The Young Voices believe it too. Roll led them to the Choir Tower. They want to sing the Final Song tonight — to follow them."
story.sounders.dlg.eldest.r1: "Then hurry. And be kind to them. They only miss their families."
story.sounders.dlg.roll.n0: "Star traveller! Tonight we sing the Final Song. Our people rose to a higher place — we want to follow them."
story.sounders.dlg.roll.c0_good: They didn't rise. They crossed over, into the Qualis' world.
story.sounders.dlg.roll.r0_weak: "Why should we listen to a stranger?"
story.sounders.dlg.roll.n1: "But the Great Song made us strong. It built cities!"
story.sounders.dlg.roll.c1_good: It built cities here — and broke homes over there. Kamo told me.
story.sounders.dlg.roll.r1_good: "Kamo… the builder from the old songs?"
story.sounders.dlg.roll.n2: "Then why did our food disappear? The Great Song was meant to save us."
story.sounders.dlg.roll.c2_good: The Qualis were protecting their home. Feya heard them.
story.sounders.dlg.roll.n3: "If you're right… we can never hear them again."
story.sounders.dlg.roll.c3_good: You can — with a quiet song that changes nothing. Tini taught me: the Bridge Song.
story.sounders.dlg.roll.r3_good: "A song that changes nothing — and lets us listen? Show us. We sing, you play the second voice."
